name: Rasan Information Technology Company
note: Saudi fintech/insurtech group (Tameeni, Treza), listed on the Saudi Exchange (Tadawul: 8313) since May 2024. Its 2024 IPO prospectus names the 5%+ shareholders: Impact Funds for Financial Technology Company, Assets Custody Development Impact Company and four individuals (Theib AlMutairi, Muheideb AlMuheideb, Samer Raslan, Mohammed AlMuheideb); no state holding found.
